bounded_host_request.command:
set -euo pipefail
cd "$HOME/Project/Gserver/projects/TGtumbler/GateApp-Bot"
stage="deploy/state/help-compact-final-20261123"
old_sha="db730471a961f54700fde3e1761d3b7f9dbcaf206291f202936240f5bc5c54aa"
new_sha="f5c3b09b915031b94c1b2c9ab86b5c4af74a52bc73256dfc758920d714fb3106"
test -s "$stage/gaybbs-target-only.mjs"
test "$(sha256sum "$stage/gaybbs-target-only.mjs"|cut -d' ' -f1)" = "$new_sha"
test "$(docker exec deploy-gaybbs-1 sha256sum /app/gaybbs.mjs|cut -d' ' -f1)" = "$old_sha"
test "$(docker inspect -f '{{.State.Running}}' deploy-gaybbs-1)" = "true"
test "$(systemctl --user is-active gace-userbot-verify.service)" = active
test "$(docker inspect -f '{{.State.Running}}' deploy-postgres-1)" = "true"
test ! -e deploy/state/help-profile-deploy-20261123.json
backup="gace-tgtumbler-gaybbs:before-help-profile-20261123"
new="gace-tgtumbler-gaybbs:help-profile-20261123"
old_image="$(docker image inspect -f '{{.Id}}' gace-tgtumbler-gaybbs:local)"
test "$(docker inspect -f '{{.Image}}' deploy-gaybbs-1)" = "$old_image"
docker image tag gace-tgtumbler-gaybbs:local "$backup"
cat > "$stage/Dockerfile.help" <<'EOF'
FROM gace-tgtumbler-gaybbs:before-help-profile-20261123
COPY --chown=1000:1000 --chmod=600 gaybbs-target-only.mjs /app/gaybbs.mjs
RUN node --check /app/gaybbs.mjs
EOF
docker build --no-cache -q -t "$new" -f "$stage/Dockerfile.help" "$stage" >/dev/null
new_image="$(docker image inspect -f '{{.Id}}' "$new")"
test "$new_image" != "$old_image"
test "$(docker image inspect -f '{{.Config.User}}' "$new")" = node
printf '{"state":"STAGED_VERIFIED","old_image":"%s","new_image":"%s","old_bundle":"%s","new_bundle":"%s","source_pr":72,"changed_chapters":["src/bot/operationHelpHandlers.ts","src/gaybbsBot.ts"]}\n' "$old_image" "$new_image" "$old_sha" "$new_sha" > "$stage/build-checkpoint.json"
echo "HELP_COMPACT_PRODUCTION_IMAGE_BUILT_WITH_OWNER_AND_SYNTAX=PASS"
